title: Taking the free 'plain sword' at the Forge granted a permanent perk (Keen Edge, +1 to hit) but the Combat status line kept showing 'short sword' as the equipped weapon for the rest of the 593-turn game; there is no equip/swap action anywhere, so the second weapon exists purely to trigger its one-time perk and then sits inert.
where: The Forge, 'take the plain sword from the wall'; status screen 'Combat:' line thereafter
